544:t_2:336.en:
$$レナード$$
「But if we correct this distorted history, she will live her life as an ordinary person.」

544:t_2:337.en:
$$レナード$$
「No one will come after her. She will live in peace, fall in love, have children, and grow old...」

544:t_2:338.en:
$$レナード$$
「She will live exactly as you wish. This is the only solution.」

544:t_2:339.en:
$$宗介$$
(What this man says may make sense... But...)

544:t_2:341.en:
$$宗介$$
(In that corrected history... I won't be beside $$千鳥$$ as she lives a happy life...)

544:t_2:342.en:
$$宗介$$
(I would never even meet $$千鳥$$... That world... means nothing to me...)

544:t_2:343.en:
$$レナード$$
「...It is nearly time for this truce to end.」

544:t_2:344.en:
$$レナード$$
「Now we have a way out.」

544:t_2:345.en:
$$宗介$$
(If his plan really is possible, isn't it the only way to return $$千鳥$$ to a peaceful world...?)

544:t_2:346.en:
$$宗介$$
($$千鳥$$... What... should I do...?)

544:t_2:347.en:
$$レナード$$
「Now... Shall we start trying to kill each other?」

544:t_2:348.en:
$$宗介$$
「...I... won't do that right now...」

544:t_2:349.en:
$$レナード$$
「That suits me. Then shall we vent our frustrations some other day?」

544:t_2:351.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'll tell you one last thing. I will achieve my goal even if I have to make an enemy of the entire world.」

544:t_2:352.en:
$$レナード$$
「If you just stand by, that's fine. But if you face me again, I won't hold back. I'll use everything I have to kill you.」

544:t_2:354.en:
$$宗介$$
(For now, I just have to find $$千鳥$$ before he does...)

544:t_2:358.en: ～$$ヤムスク１１$$ Underground Facility　Deepest Level～

544:t_2:360.en:
$$テッサ$$
(This is... the deepest level... and the center from which the Tau waves radiate.)

544:t_2:361.en:
$$かなめ$$
(My consciousness... is merging with $$テッサ$$'s...)

544:t_2:362.en:
$$テッサ$$
(It is probably a phenomenon similar to resonance...)

544:t_2:364.en:
$$かなめ$$
(She was the test subject 18 years ago, though I don't know who she is...)

544:t_2:365.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Then why is her body in this condition?)

544:t_2:366.en:
$$かなめ$$
(No... Her original body decayed long ago.)

544:t_2:367.en:
$$かなめ$$
(What is here is a remnant of her existence... which her mind manifested through the $$オムニ・スフィア$$ over many years...)

544:t_2:368.en:
$$かなめ$$
(This remnant of her is the Whisperer... She will revive at some unknown time in the future and control me with even greater power...)

544:t_2:369.en:
$$かなめ$$
(That is why $$テッサ$$ intends to destroy this place...)

544:t_2:370.en:
$$かなめ$$
(If we destroy this catalyst that converts and emits Tau waves from another era, $$ヤムスク１１$$ will be freed from its curse...)

544:t_2:371.en:
$$かなめ$$
(But the same crystal will grow again in time... This doesn't solve the root of the problem.)

544:t_2:372.en:
$$かなめ$$
(We can't stop the Whisperer from appearing... In that case...)

544:t_2:373.en:
???
(You understand quite well, my daughter. I'm glad you've come.)

544:t_2:374.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I know this voice. I've known it... for a long time...)

544:t_2:375.en:
???
(Yes... I was waiting for you. I have called to you many times... Each time, you resisted and shut out my voice.)

544:t_2:376.en:
???
(But this was ordained... You came here. You can no longer reject me.)

544:t_2:378.en:
???
(You need fear no longer... Reach out your hand. Open your heart...)

544:t_2:379.en:
???
(Fill your heart with joy and boundless delight.)

544:t_2:381.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$カナメ$$! I'm going to destroy this capsule! Please stand back!」

544:t_2:383.en:
$$かなめ$$
「There is no need for that anymore.」

544:t_2:385.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Let's go, $$テッサ$$. We have no more business here...」

544:t_2:391.en:
$$宗介$$
(Something is wrong... Is that... $$千鳥$$...?)

544:t_2:394.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I have a gun. If you move, I'll shoot $$テッサ$$.」

544:t_2:395.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm sorry, $$相良$$... I didn't foresee this...」

544:t_2:396.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But I think $$カナメ$$ is...」

544:t_2:397.en:
$$かなめ$$
「No, $$テッサ$$. Don't go blabbing without my permission.」

544:t_2:398.en:
$$宗介$$
「What's going on? It's me, $$千鳥$$. Don't you recognize me?」

544:t_2:399.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Of course I do. It's been a long time, $$宗介$$.」

544:t_2:400.en:
$$宗介$$
(There's no doubt she's $$千鳥$$... But what is this...?)

544:t_2:401.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I wanted to see you so badly. Even now, all I want is to throw myself into your arms.」

544:t_2:402.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Then why are you doing this?」

544:t_2:403.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I have an important job I must do, one $$ソフィア$$ asked me to do.」

544:t_2:404.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I love you very much, but if you interfere, I'll have to kill you.」

544:t_2:406.en:
$$テッサ$$
「That's the... name of the girl who was in the capsule...」

544:t_2:407.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I told you not to talk, $$テッサ$$.」

544:t_2:408.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$千鳥$$, if this is a joke, stop it. This is no time for that.」

544:t_2:409.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Yes, I know. ...If only it were a joke... You're desperately clinging to that hope right now, aren't you?」

544:t_2:410.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I understand why you're confused. But I want you to be brave and accept it.」

544:t_2:411.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It is because accepting it leads to the power to make this world better.」

544:t_2:414.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Let me leave. Otherwise I'll kill $$テッサ$$, and you'll die too.」

544:t_2:416.en:
$$宗介$$
「Stop talking nonsense...! Lower the gun and let her go!」

544:t_2:418.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I decide what I do! No one can control me! I won't let even you do that, $$宗介$$!」
